title: Lift to the Relationship Bonus Rate for Substantial Checking Relationships
content:
The bonus rate that applies to a savings or money market account of Savings & Money Market Accounts is lifted for owners whose checking relationship is substantial. Two facts are read from the owner's account under Personal Checking: the ledger balance it carries, and the direct deposits credited to it in the three calendar months ending on the review date.

Where that ledger balance is at least 6000.00 USD and those direct deposits are at least 3000.00 USD, the tier's relationship bonus annual percentage yield is lifted by 0.85 percentage points.

Where that ledger balance is at least 2500.00 USD but below 6000.00 USD and those direct deposits are at least 3000.00 USD, the tier's relationship bonus annual percentage yield is lifted by 0.35 percentage points.

Where that ledger balance is below 2500.00 USD, or those direct deposits are below 3000.00 USD, the tier's relationship bonus annual percentage yield applies unchanged.

### The direct deposit condition governs both lifts

The direct deposit figure of 3000.00 USD is common to both lifts. An owner whose Personal Checking ledger balance stands at 12000.00 USD but whose direct deposits in the window come to 2900.00 USD takes no lift at all, the same as an owner whose ledger balance stands at 900.00 USD.

| Personal Checking ledger balance | Direct deposits in the three calendar months ending on the review date | Lift |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 6000.00 USD or more | 3000.00 USD or more | 0.85 percentage points |
| at least 2500.00 USD, below 6000.00 USD | 3000.00 USD or more | 0.35 percentage points |
| below 2500.00 USD | any | none |
| any | below 3000.00 USD | none |

### Boundary figures

A ledger balance of exactly 6000.00 USD takes the 0.85 percentage point lift, and 5999.99 USD takes 0.35 so long as the direct deposit condition holds. A ledger balance of exactly 2500.00 USD takes 0.35; 2499.99 USD takes none. Direct deposits of exactly 3000.00 USD satisfy the condition.
